name: ridgeline
description: Backcountry route hazard checker: cross-references a GPX route against live wildfire, NWS alert, avalanche, river, air-quality, smoke and forecast data, with estimated trail conditions.

scripts.cap:assets: node scripts/generate-mobile-assets.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --ios --iconBackgroundColor '#1d2622' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#1d2622' --splashBackgroundColor '#141916' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#141916' && node scripts/generate-mobile-assets.mjs --post-android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
